name: Zalaszombatfa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaszombatfa (a green and blue shield with ears of grain and a church within a red and white lozengy border) below the name ZALASZOMBATFA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
